agent_position: Eight distributions chosen by consumer need, including an access/credits split of the family kit.
owner_disposition: Derive the set from ARCHITECTURE.md alone: a split only where the scope rule, the route-contract pattern, or dependency weight forces one. The access/credits split is deferred with a revisit trigger; the kit splits by role side instead.
summary: Distribution set derived from the mandated rules rather than chosen; credits split deferred.

agent_position: Move the purchase shape and the message, terms, receipt, and result carriers into the family vocabulary.
owner_disposition: ARCHITECTURE.md forbids the vocabulary depending on core; the carriers extend core schemas, so only the purchase shape moves to the vocabulary and the carriers go to the storefront-side kit.
summary: Vocabulary takes only what needs no core import.

agent_position: Keep arkhai-apicredits-middleware published as a thin re-export of the gate so existing installs keep working.
owner_disposition: Retire it. There are no third-party sellers today, and sellers are expected to take pre-built images rather than packages, so the old name protects nothing.
summary: The published middleware is retired, not shelled.
